sections: ENG-0051 Monitoring and Data Logging

ENG-0051: Monitoring and Data Logging for a Course Registration Service. Department: Software Engineering. Type: hardware/software. Original suggested final year project, not a completed student thesis. Aim: develop and evaluate monitoring and data logging for course registration service. Method: Build a timestamped acquisition and dashboard pipeline; where physical access is unavailable use a labelled simulator. Calibrate against a reference and record missing observations. Scope: one course registration service prototype or model, one baseline and three test conditions. Tools: Python, CSV/SQLite and a plotting dashboard; sensor projects may use a low voltage microcontroller with suitable calibrated sensors. Evaluation: calibration error, missing sample fraction, latency and storage cost. Set acceptance targets with a supervisor before collecting results. Deliverables: requirements, system diagram, reproducible code, labelled test data, results and limitations. Learning resource: Arduino sensor and serial examples: https://docs.arduino.cc/built-in-examples/. This explains the implementation method, not proof that this proposed project has been completed. Use supervised bench models or simulation for hazardous systems; biomedical proposals are nonclinical. Establish department-specific theory and feasibility with the supervisor.
